pages.title: Coach home (redirect)
pages.where: Not a page a coach opens from the sidebar. Opening /coach sends them straight to the Academy (Community).
pages.summary: This is a blank 'Redirecting…' page that sends the coach to the Academy Community page.
pages.notes: Coaches only see 'Redirecting…' for a moment, or an error like 'Unable to load your profile.' or 'Coach record not found. Ask an admin to create a row in the 'coaches' table with your id and slug.' Admins who are not viewing as a coach are sent to the admin community page. Point coaches to Academy in the sidebar instead.

pages.title: Old programme link (redirect)
pages.where: Not a page coaches open directly. Old links go to Academy → Classroom.
pages.summary: Old programme link that sends the coach straight to that programme's card in the Classroom, or to the Classroom if the programme isn't found.
pages.notes: This is only a redirect with nothing on screen. Point coaches to Academy → Classroom to find a programme instead.

pages.title: Old programme archive link
pages.where: Not reachable from the sidebar. Old links to a programme go to the Classroom (Academy → Classroom) instead.
pages.summary: This is a retired page that sends the coach straight to the matching programme card in the Classroom.
pages.notes: Coaches never see this page, it only redirects. If someone asks about an old programme link, point them to Academy → Classroom.

pages.title: Classroom
pages.where: Academy → Classroom
pages.summary: Browse the training courses, see how far you have got in each, and open a lesson.
controls: Course cards at the top (Start Here, Coach Action Plan, Going Pro, Get Calls, Win Clients, Coach Clients): each shows a picture, a small label such as Onboarding or Sales, the course name, a short description and a progress bar
Progress bar and text on each card: shows the lesson count, then "X of Y complete" once your progress has loaded
**The Portfolio System** banner under the course cards: opens the step-by-step map of the process, from finding clients to keeping them
**Open the map** on the Portfolio System banner (on wide screens the whole banner is clickable and the grey strip with an arrow at the right does the same)
**The Vault** section at the bottom: extra courses with books, talks and how-tos
**Show** / **Hide** on the Vault strip (a down arrow at the right): opens or closes the Vault, and the page remembers your choice on this device
Vault course cards (Personal growth, Book summaries, Tools & set-up), shown when the Vault is open
Coach talks row inside the Vault: video thumbnails with length, talk title and the speaker's name
Tick circle next to a lesson (inside a course): **Mark lesson as done** / **Mark lesson as not done**
pages.notes: Clicking a course card opens its first lesson. The Vault starts closed for new coaches and opens by itself once you have started a Vault lesson. Lessons marked as draft are for admins only, so coaches never see them.

pages.title: Classroom course (entry redirect)
pages.where: Academy → Classroom, then pick a course
pages.summary: This page shows nothing itself; it sends the coach straight to the first lesson of the chosen course, or back to the Classroom list if the course is retired or has no lessons.
pages.notes: Coaches never see this page as a screen because it always redirects. Ava should point them to the Classroom lesson page they land on instead. An unknown course shows a not-found page.

pages.title: System
pages.where: Academy → Classroom → System (the lead-flow map; open Academy in the sidebar, go to Classroom, then choose the system map)
pages.summary: See the whole path from finding ideal clients to keeping them as a map, hover or click any step to read about it, and open the matching lesson.
controls: **Classroom** link at top left, goes back to the Classroom
Step 1 box **Find Your Ideal Clients** with cards **Choose Your Ideal Client**, **Define the Problem You Solve**, **Build Your Prospect List**
Step 2 box **Set Up Your Pipeline** with cards **Optimise Your LinkedIn Profile**, **Create Your Lead Capture**, **Set Up Your Call Booking**
Step 3 box **Lead Generation & Win Clients** with the flow map (Prospect Lists, Interest Sequence, Reply Sequence, Discovery Call, Value Session, New Client and the Yes/No questions)
**Customise funnel** button in the step 3 header opens a panel
Sliders **Reachable**, **Interested**, **Booked**, **Qualified**, **Won** in the funnel panel
**New clients** box with minus and plus buttons (1 to 50) in the funnel panel
**Reset** and close (X) buttons in the funnel panel
Step 4 box **Build Authority** with cards **Run Your Newsletter**, **Email Your List**, **Post on Social**
Step 5 box **Keep Clients** with cards **Onboard New Clients**, **Deliver Coaching**, **Retain & Renew**
**Open lesson** button in the pop-up when you hover a card or map step
**Close** button in the detail box that opens when you click a map step
Small info (i) icon on each step header shows what that step is for
pages.notes: Hovering a card or map step shows a pop-up with details; clicking a map step opens a detail box below the map. The newsletter, email list and social cards say "Lesson coming soon." and have no link. Funnel settings are saved in the coach's browser only.

pages.title: Weekly Focus
pages.where: Academy → Classroom → This Week's Focus
pages.summary: Read this week's focus and action, listen to the audio, and look back at past weeks.
controls: **Classroom** link at the top, goes back to the Classroom
**This Week’s Focus** label above the title (shows **Past Focus** when viewing an older week)
**This week’s action** box with the one thing to do
**Listen** audio player, shown only when the week has audio
Lesson text under the action box, shown only when the week has text
**Open** button at the bottom, named after the related learning path (e.g. "Open [path name]")
**Back to this week** button, shown only when viewing a past week
**Past weeks** list, each row has its week number, path, title, action and an **Open** link
pages.notes: The audio and lesson text load a moment after the page and only appear if that week has them. The **Past weeks** list only shows once there are earlier weeks. Weekly Focus is not in the main sidebar; coaches reach it from the Classroom.

pages.title: Weekly Focus
pages.where: Academy → Classroom → open a Weekly Focus week
pages.summary: Read one week's focus, its action, and any audio or lesson text, then jump to the related learning path or go back to earlier weeks.
controls: **Classroom** link at the top, goes back to the Classroom
**This Week’s Focus** or **Past Focus** label above the title, showing which kind of week it is
**This week’s action** box with the task for the week
**Listen** audio player, shown only when the week has audio
Lesson text below the action, shown only when the week has lesson text
**Open** button at the bottom, named after the related path (for example "Open [path name]"), goes to that learning path
**Back to this week** button, shown only on a past week
**Past weeks** list with each week's number, path, title and action, each with an **Open** link
pages.notes: The audio and lesson text load after the page opens, so they may appear a moment later or not at all if the week has none. The **Past weeks** list only appears once there are past weeks.

pages.title: The Resource Library
pages.where: Academy → Resources
pages.summary: Browse, search and open every guide, sheet, deck and template for winning clients, running sessions and using the Profit System.
controls: **Search inside every resource** box at the top of the page
**All**, **Docs**, **Sheets**, **Slides**, **Files**, **Videos**, **Reading** buttons under the search box, each with a count, to show only one type
**Get clients** section: tap to open its guides (BOSS Scorecard marketing workshop, message sequences, newsletter, follow-up)
**Keep clients** section: tap to open its guides (onboarding, masterfile, Sessions 1 to 4, how to open and close)
**Profit System** section: tap to open tools laid out in three columns, **Vision**, **Velocity** and **Value**
Tap any resource to open it
**The Resource Library** link at the top of the left contents panel, back to this page
**Overview** link in the left contents panel
**Search inside resources** box in the left contents panel, shows matching pages with a short excerpt
Section and folder rows in the left contents panel, tap to open or close and see the page count
**Contents** button on phones, opens or closes the contents panel
**Collapse contents** / **Expand contents** button on computers, shrinks or opens the left panel
**The old Resources list** link at the bottom of the left contents panel
pages.notes: Search looks inside the pages, but the page text loads a moment after sign-in, so results may be thin at first. Results show **Nothing matches** if nothing fits; try fewer words or clear the filter.

pages.title: Resource page
pages.where: Academy → Resources → open any resource
pages.summary: Read one resource from the library, and copy, download or open its sheets, slides and files.
controls: **Watch the lesson** button at the top (only on pages with a lesson)
**Download PDF** button at the top (only on pages with a written document)
**Make a copy** button on a Google Sheet or Slides card
**View the master** button on a Google Sheet card
**Open** button on a Slides card
**Download** button on a file card
**Open in Drive** button on a file card
**How to run it** link beside a group of sheet tabs
**Watch the video** button when a video can't play on the page
**Previous** and **Next** links at the bottom, which step through the whole library
pages.notes: The page shows "Loading…" first, and if it fails it says "This resource didn't load. Sign in again, or refresh the page." What each page contains varies, so only some of these buttons appear on any one page. Some reading links carry a warning note, and broken links are shown crossed out.

pages.title: Resource list
pages.where: Academy → Resources → ← The Resource Library link leads to the Resource Library; this older list page is reached from there
pages.summary: Browse or search the original list of Academy resource links, grouped by area, and open any of them in a new tab.

tabs.label: Area switch (buttons at the top; names come from the app and are not shown in the page code)

controls: **← The Resource Library** link at the top, goes back to the Resource Library page
Area buttons in a row at the top, the first area is open by default
**Search resources…** box, searches title, topic, link and section name across all areas
Count line, e.g. "12 resources in" the chosen area
Section headings that open and close with a click, with a number showing how many resources are inside
Topic headings inside sections that also open and close
Document groups with a note "One file · each link opens a different tab or sheet"
**Open full document** link inside a document group
Table columns **Resource** and **Type** (search results also show **Topic**)
Resource title links that open in a new tab
**No resources match your search.** message when a search finds nothing
pages.notes: This is the old link list, kept while the Resource Library is being tested. The trash icon and the "Admin mode" note are admin-only, so coaches never see them and Ava must not offer deleting. I could not confirm the exact area button names or the exact sidebar route to this page from the code.

pages.title: Ava
pages.where: Not in the sidebar lists given; the page opens at /coach/ava (Ava is the assistant inside the app).
pages.summary: The coach opens the full Ava page to chat with Ava, the app's AI assistant.
pages.notes: The page code only loads the main Ava screen, so its buttons and fields are not shown here. Ava should not describe specific labels on this page beyond saying it is the full-page chat with her.

pages.title: My Blueprint
pages.where: My Blueprint in the sidebar
pages.summary: See where each page of your practice plan stands, and open any page to work on it.
controls: **Your Blueprint** heading with a **?** button (How your Blueprint works) that opens a pop-up with Where you are, a video, and what each status means
**List** / **Board** switch at the top right: List shows pages in groups, Board shows a card per page in status columns
Checklist of setup steps under the intro text
Page rows in List view, each with its title, a short line, a chat count (e.g. "2 new") and a status label
Status labels: **Needs you**, **BCA**, **In progress**, **Review**, **Done**
Board columns, one per status; cards open the page. An empty Needs you column folds into a thin strip
**Where you are** steps in the pop-up: talk to Ava, the Blueprint Call, then BCA builds your practice; a tick means done
Chat panel on the right opens with page chats; **Close panel** closes it
pages.notes: Each page has its own chat and, when its status is Review, a **Sign off this page** button. The Checklist/Timeline switch, Ava's drafts, Release and the BCA status menu are admin-only; never offer them to coaches. Opens on the List view by default, and the List or Board choice is remembered.

pages.title: One Blueprint page
pages.where: My Blueprint → pick a page from the contents or the links on the Blueprint
pages.summary: Read one page of your practice Blueprint on its own and answer or edit the parts that are yours to fill in.
controls: **You tell us** and **BCA writes it, you can edit it** key explaining which boxes are yours to fill and which BCA wrote
Part buttons at the top of a long page (such as About you) that jump to each part, ticked once done
Section boxes you can fill in or edit on the page
**How to do it, in the Classroom** box with links to lessons, on pages that have them
**Lead lists** page: the lists built for you and how each one searches LinkedIn, with how many people came in
**Decisions** page: **Agreed**, **Proposed by BCA** or **With BCA** label on each group of decisions
pages.notes: The page opens from a Blueprint page link, so there is no tab row here. If the page name is not a real Blueprint page it shows a not-found page. Edit, Save and Cancel on the Decisions page, and Ava's plan, import and re-plan on Lead lists, are for BCA admins only, so never offer them to coaches.}

pages.title: Blueprint (whole document)
pages.where: My Blueprint → Blueprint
pages.summary: Read your whole practice blueprint as one document, see what is still needed from you, and jump to any chapter or page.
controls: **Your Portfolio Blueprint** or **The Practice Blueprint** cover at the top with your name and how many sections are written
**Still needed from you** box listing what you still have to fill in, each linking to its section
**Talk it through** button in the Still needed box, opens Ava
**Contents** list of numbered chapters and their pages, each a link
Chapters one after another, each with its pages and sections
**How to do it, in the Classroom** links at the end of some pages
**Decision Record** page with the agreed decisions, shown read-only
**Lead lists** page showing the lists built for you and how each searches LinkedIn
Part buttons at the top of some pages that scroll to each part, ticked when done
**Why we build it for you** welcome video from Zander, if shown on the cover
pages.notes: The Still needed box only appears when something is missing. The Write my blueprint button, Edit on the Decision Record, and Ava's plan on Lead lists are for BCA only, so never offer them to coaches. Download is not on this page itself.

pages.title: Your plan (jobs)
pages.where: Not reachable by coaches. It sits under My Blueprint at /coach/blueprint/jobs, but only admins can open it.
pages.summary: An admin-only list of launch jobs (Launch, Get calls, Get clients, Keep clients) with status, progress and chat, as a List or Board.
pages.notes: Coaches are sent straight back to My Blueprint if they open this page, so Ava must never point a coach here. It is a new page that admins use until it is ready.

pages.title: BOSS Score
pages.where: Keep Clients → BOSS Score
pages.summary: Pick a client or prospect, score them across the BOSS playbooks, and see their charts, insights and priorities.
controls: **Keep Clients** page heading with the section tabs above it (Clients, BOSS Score, Playbooks, Profit Levers, Client Simulator)
Contact list at the top, where you choose someone from your list
**+ Add new person** option in the list, to score someone who is not listed yet
Name, title and business fields for a new person, then **Start session**
Session menu in the top right once someone is chosen, with options to change the session, view their scorecard and copy the client dashboard link
Score dials at the top for the total and the three pillars
BOSS grid, where you set each playbook's score and add notes
**Owner level completeness** card with a bar for each level
**BOSS wheel** card showing area scores
Answer mix bar with on-track, building, needs attention and not answered counts
**Insights** card with a refresh button, topic tabs (Overview, Levels, Pillars, Areas) and **See full overview**
**Charts** card (score breakdown and focus areas) when Score together is off and there are scores
Scorecard pop-up titled BOSS Score with a close button, opened from the session menu
pages.notes: Scores save on their own and a green "Scores saved." message appears. The scorecard option only shows if the person has completed a BOSS Score scorecard. The prospect priority matrix and coach picker for new people are admin-only, so don't offer them to coaches. Insights only show once a person is chosen and are written automatically after scoring.

pages.title: Calls
pages.where: Win Clients → Calls
pages.summary: See every booked sales call in a calendar or list, mark how each call went, add a call for a prospect, and manage your booking pages.
controls: **Search calls…** box at the top left
**Filter** button (in calendar view: Calendars and Type; in list view: Timing and Call status)
**Sort** button (list view only): Sort by Call time, Date added, Prospect or Call status, plus Order
**Booking pages** button opens your booking calendars, weekly hours and calendar connections
**Calendar view** and **List view** icon buttons switch the layout
**Add a call** button: pick a prospect in the **Add a call** pop-up, then choose a calendar and time and press **Confirm**
**Today**, previous and next arrows, and **Day** / **Week** / **Month** buttons move around the calendar
Click a call in the calendar for its pop-up: **Join meeting**, **Watch recording**, status buttons (Confirmed, Completed, No-show, Cancelled), and **Open contact** or **Close**
**Call status** drop-down on each row in list view changes the outcome
**Connect calendar** banner shows Google or Outlook events next to your calls

In Booking pages: **Your pages** card with **Edit page** and a copy-link button, and **Booking calendars** with **New calendar**, an on/off switch, **Call page** and **Booking page** edit buttons, and a copy link button
In Booking pages: **Weekly hours** with **Timezone** and **Save hours**, and a **Calls** back link
pages.notes: Clicking a call row opens the client's page only if you have access to Keep Clients. The Coach filter and Coach column are never shown to coaches. Connecting Google or Outlook is optional; bookings work without it. The Call page button only shows when call pages are live.

pages.title: Campaigns
pages.where: Get Calls → Campaigns
pages.summary: See all your outreach campaigns, switch them on or off, create new ones, and follow what is due, planned and done.
controls: **New Campaign** button at the top right (opens a pop-up with **Name**, **Channel** LinkedIn/Email/WhatsApp, and **Blank** or **Templates**)
**Sending settings** button at the top right (only shows once LinkedIn is connected)
**On/Off** switch at the start of each campaign row
**Campaign**, **Via**, **Connect** and **Replies** columns in the campaigns table
Drag handle on each row to reorder campaigns
**Campaign actions** menu (three dots) on each row: **Edit**, **Settings**, **Duplicate**, **Save as template**, **Archive**, **Delete**
**Archived** bar under the table: opens archived campaigns, whose menu offers **Unarchive**
**To do**, **Planned** and **Done** tabs in the activity panel on the right, listing lead, status and next step
**Social Selling Index** card with a **Breakdown** button
**Pending invites** card with an **Auto-clean** switch
**Connect LinkedIn** button on the right-hand cards when LinkedIn is not connected
**Create campaign** button when you have no campaigns yet
pages.notes: LinkedIn must be connected before a LinkedIn campaign can be switched on; email campaigns need Gmail or Outlook, and WhatsApp campaigns need WhatsApp connected. Lead Lists and Lead Magnets are other tabs in the Get Calls row. A floating Sample data switch appears only for staff and the demo coach, so coaches never see it.

pages.title: One campaign
pages.where: Get Calls → Campaigns, then click a campaign
pages.summary: Run one outreach campaign: switch it on or off, see how it is doing, manage the people in it, and write its steps.
controls: **← Campaigns** link at the top to go back to the list
On/off switch next to the campaign name (turn campaign on or off)
Pencil button next to the name (**Edit campaign name**)
**Save template** button: saves the steps and sending settings as your own template
**Duplicate** button: choose Steps, People, or Steps and people; the copy starts switched off
**Settings** button: opens the campaign settings, where you can archive or delete it
**Overview** tab: **By status** chart with **View all** and **Add prospects**, **Conversion** dials, **Daily activity** chart
**Prospects** tab: table of people in the campaign, with add, pause, resume, move and delete
**Steps** tab: build the sequence, add steps, connect an account, and **Choose a template**
**Before you launch** style warning bar: shows things to fix before going live, with Show/Hide
**Join a BCA group test** box with **Join this test** and **Leave test**
**Add people** choices: **Already in the system**, **Add one person**, **Sales Navigator**, **Google Maps**, **Google Search**, **Upload CSV**
pages.notes: The on/off switch only works once the matching account (LinkedIn, email or WhatsApp) is connected, and it is locked for archived campaigns. The group test box does not show for email campaigns. Campaigns made from a lead magnet automatically open on their lead magnet page instead.

pages.title: Pending connection requests
pages.where: Get Calls → Campaigns, then open the pending invites page (the "← Campaigns" link on this page leads back to Campaigns)
pages.summary: Withdraw old pending LinkedIn connection requests by hand or let them clear automatically, so new invites keep going out.
controls: **← Campaigns** link at the top, goes back to Campaigns
**Pending load** box with a dial showing how many requests are pending, and a **Refresh** button
**Auto-clean** box with an on/off switch (**Auto-clean pending invites**) that keeps you under the limit, oldest first
**Withdraw now** box with a number box (plus and minus buttons) for how many of the oldest to withdraw
**Withdraw (number) oldest** button, asks you to confirm and can't be undone
List of pending requests showing name, description and age (Today, 1 day, days)
**Withdraw** button on each request in the list, asks you to confirm
**Nothing pending** message when the list is empty
pages.notes: Needs LinkedIn connected, otherwise the list may fail to load and show an error. The dial warns when pending requests are high: new invites slow over the limit and pause at the top limit. The number shown and the daily Auto-clean limits come from the page itself.

pages.title: One lead magnet
pages.where: Get Calls → Lead Magnets → open a lead magnet (for example the BOSS Score)
pages.summary: See who opted in, started and finished a lead magnet, share its link, and edit the follow-up emails sent to people.
controls: **Settings** button at the top right: pop-up called Lead magnet settings with **This app** or **My old CRM** under "Who emails people after they take one?"
**Connect your email** and **Rename it** links inside Settings
Magnet title, picture and public link, with a **Copy** button next to the link
**Add a public link** shown when no public link is set up yet
**Edit your page** button (BOSS Score only)
**Share** button: pop-up with **Your public URL** box and **Save**, plus share settings
Date range dropdown (Last 7 days, Last 14 days, Last 30 days, Last 90 days, All time, Custom range) with **From** and **To** dates; BOSS Score also shows a views count
Overview: **By stage** chart with **View all**, plus **Opted in** and **Completed** percentage dials
People: stage buttons (**All**, plus the stage names), **Search name or email** box, and a table with Person, Stage, Score and When; click a row to open that person
Sequences: a tab for each follow-up sequence, where you add, edit, copy, reorder and delete steps and insert merge fields
**Notify me when** box beside the sequence: **Add alert** with **Bell**, **Email** and **WhatsApp** switches
pages.notes: Emails to people only go out from this app if the sender in Settings is **This app**; connect your email so they come from you. The **Opted in** dial shows only for the BOSS Score. If the magnet isn't found, the page shows "Lead magnet not found" with a **← Back to lead magnets** link.

pages.title: Keep Clients
pages.where: Keep Clients in the sidebar (the Clients tab)
pages.summary: See everyone you coach with their price and join date, add or edit clients, and open a client's BOSS Score or coaching workspace.
controls: **Add client** button at the top right opens the **Add a client** box
**Import** button next to the **LinkedIn profile** field pulls in a name and business from a LinkedIn link
**Or add them yourself** fields in the Add a client box: **Person**, **Business**, **Joined**, **Price / month**, **Problem notes**, then **Save client**
**Add many** button opens **Add all your clients at once** to paste a list from Excel or Google Sheets
**Copy the column headings** button in the Add many box, then the **Add (number) clients** button
**Search** box at the top right (only shows once you have 6 or more clients)
**Your best clients** card showing what your best clients have in common (Sector, Turnover, Team size, How they found you)
Clients table with columns **Person**, **Business**, **Joined**, **With you**, **Price / month**, **BOSS**, **Notes**
Click a client row to open its edit form
Edit form fields: **Sector**, **How they found you**, **Turnover**, **Team size**, **Result you got them**, **More like them? (1 to 5)**, **LinkedIn profile**, then **Save**
**Open BOSS Score** or **Run BOSS Score** link in the edit form, and the score number or **Run** in the BOSS column
**Coaching workspace** link in the edit form
Small LinkedIn icon on a row opens that client's LinkedIn profile
pages.notes: If a coach has no access to the client area, they are sent to the Academy community page instead. With no clients yet, the Add a client box shows open straight away. Admins who aren't viewing as a coach are sent to the admin area.

pages.title: Community
pages.where: Academy → Community
pages.summary: Read and write posts, wins and questions with other coaches, and filter the feed by category.
controls: **Write something…** box at the top opens the new post box
**Title** and **Write something…** fields in the new post box
**Where to post** drop-down in the new post box (pick a category)
**Post** button and **Cancel** button in the new post box
**Add photos or videos** and **Add a video** buttons in the new post box (video box takes a YouTube, Loom, Vimeo or Wistia link, then **ADD**)
**Add a poll** button in the new post box, with **Add option** and **Remove poll**

**Previous**, page numbers and **Next** at the bottom of the feed

Side panel next to the feed (community sidebar)

Admin-only parts, never offer them to coaches: Announcements category, Write with Ava, Also send to WhatsApp, Schedule post and Scheduled posts. The Feedback category shows only if the coach's plan includes the feedback channel.

pages.title: One community post

pages.notes: This page has nothing of its own on screen. The post is shown by the shared Community feed layout, so Ava should send coaches to Academy → Community and not describe any buttons here.

pages.title: Calendar
pages.where: Academy → Calendar
pages.summary: See community events and calls in a month, week or list view, open an event for details, and watch recordings of past calls.
controls: **Today** button at top left jumps back to today
Arrows before and after the month name move to the previous or next month (or week in week view)
Clock line under the month name (e.g. "5:00pm London time") opens a list of time zones to switch to
**Subscribe** button at top right adds the calendar to your own calendar app
**Calendar layout** drop-down with **Week** and **Month** (calendar view only, desktop)
**Calendar view** and **List view** icon buttons switch between the grid and the list
Click an event in the grid or list to open its pop-up with time, location link, description and links
**Watch recording** button on past events that have a recording
Past events without a recording may show a short note where the recording would be

pages.title: Members
pages.where: Academy → Community → Members (or click Members, Online or Admins in the Profit Coach Community box on the right)
pages.summary: Browse everyone in the Profit Coach community, see who is online, and add your own location to the members map.
controls: **Members**, **Online** and **Admins** filter buttons, each with a count, at the top of the list
**List** and **Map** switch at the top

Member cards showing name, @handle, business name, bio, Online/Offline tag, Last seen, Joined date and location
**View profile** button on a member card (only for members listed in the directory)
**Previous**, **Next** and page numbers under the list when there is more than one page of 20
Map view: **Your location** box in the top right with a **City, region, country** field and a save (disk) button
Map view: **Place pin on map** button (shows **Update map pin** once you have a pin)
